inputs: activities via text/voice/upload; mood+energy check-in; Apple Health export (workouts, resting HR, sleep); .ics calendar; profile (name, age, routine, persona)
agent: perceive (logs, check-in, calendar, health facts) -> reason (deterministic: pace vs own goals + cited guidelines, adapted to self-reported capacity) -> act (nudges, calendar-aware time triggers, voice logging, guided breathing) -> remember (local state)
safety: crisis/distress detection on the user’s own words (voice, check-in note, log text) runs before everything; crisis -> hotlines (US 988, TH 1323, findahelpline.com), calm delivery regardless of persona, no goal pressure
voice: browser STT (may use an online service; disclosed) + deterministic on-device intent (ask.js) + browser TTS; opt-in wake word
outputs: progress vs own goals and cited healthy-aging guidelines; one evidence-anchored next step; recap (spoken); celebration chime
refused: diagnosis, mental-state inference, disease-risk prediction, biological-age computation — stated plainly in-app and in voice
